name: Bragg Raw Organic Apple Cider Vinegar with Mother (Acetic Acid Warning)
whyItWorks: Despite popular wellness claims, raw unfiltered apple cider vinegar contains concentrated 5% acetic acid and unpasteurized microbial mother. Drinking ACV burns raw esophageal and gastric mucosal ulcers and frequently triggers intense gastritis and abdominal pain.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warning: Never drink undiluted apple cider vinegar shots with IBD. If using for cooking in remission, use 1 teaspoon diluted in a large recipe.
watchOuts: Concentrated acetic acid causes severe heartburn, gastric ulcer irritation, and bowel hypermotility.
